# The Way of the Test

A short sample used by LinguaLeaf's API seam tests and manual demos.

## Chapter One: Red

Mr. Gupta woke early. The morning was quiet, and the sea was calm.

He wrote a failing test first. Then he made it pass!

## Chapter Two: Green

### Interlude: The Command

Run the whole suite with:

```bash
npm test -- --filter core
```
